prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop ecommerce homepage decision comp, landscape 1536×1024
Primary request: Design an alternate visual direction for the Romanian vegetable-box shop Grădina Kasper titled “The Sunlit Greenhouse Section.” Make it unmistakably a usable ecommerce homepage UI, not a poster or moodboard. The page should feel friendly, local, warm, playful with restraint, and human—not luxury. Translate the spatial grammar of an architectural daylight section into rounded greenhouse forms: a continuous wide first-viewport cutaway follows warm morning light and the product journey from growing to packing to purchase.
Input images: Image 1 is a brand/style reference for friendly rounded typography, bold green color use, and approachable ecommerce UI; Image 2 is the existing footer identity to preserve as brand evidence; Image 3 is “how it works” idea inspiration only, not an execution to copy; Image 4 is real brand photography and human greenhouse-story evidence, including the genuine Grădina Kasper logo and people. Use them as inspiration and brand grounding, not as a collage.
Scene/backdrop: Warm limewash ecommerce page. Compact rounded navigation at top with the genuine Grădina Kasper identity on the left, concise Romanian navigation in the middle, and account plus cart actions on the right. Below it, one continuous wide rounded greenhouse cutaway occupies most of the first viewport. At left, real people tend abundant vegetable rows under a translucent greenhouse roof; warm sun enters from upper left. Across the middle, the growing rows and packing path flow continuously toward the right. At right, a finished abundant vegetable box sits on a rounded packing bench with a clear product-purchase interface integrated beside it. A small glimpse of the next catalogue section may appear below the fold to reinforce that this is a full shopping page.
Subject: Grădina Kasper’s own local greenhouse vegetables, people growing them, and the featured product Cutia Family, presented as one continuous farm-to-box ecommerce story.
Style/medium: polished web UI design comp combining editorial documentary photography or finely realistic photographic rendering with crisp production-grade interface design; cheerful rounded display typography; friendly oversized but controlled radii; confident flat color blocking; subtle agricultural texture; spacious yet information-rich; distinctly Romanian local-food brand; no default component-library appearance.
Composition/framing: landscape desktop browser canvas, straight-on UI screenshot, 1536×1024 aspect. Compact navigation uses less than 10% of height. Main headline and subcopy are clearly readable without covering the greenhouse story. The continuous greenhouse section is the dominant structure, not a card grid. From left to right: sunlight, growing rows and people, subtle section-line annotations connecting harvest and packing, finished box on the rounded bench, then immediate product data and purchase action. The call to action must be highly visible above the fold. Maintain realistic webpage margins and alignments.
Lighting/mood: soft warm Romanian morning light, sun gold highlights, cool shadow-blue greenhouse structure, optimistic and honest working atmosphere.
Color palette: deep green #0B5138, warm limewash #F5F2E8, sun gold #E5B84A, shadow blue #7892A0, charcoal #1B2622, with vegetable colors used naturally.
Materials/textures: translucent greenhouse membrane, painted rounded metal ribs, soil, leaves, kraft vegetable box, lightly textured limewashed page background; all interpreted with soft rounded geometry.
Text (verbatim): “Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”; “Cutia Family”; “150 RON”; “4–5 kg”; “Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”; “Adaugă în coș”; “Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”
Typography: bold rounded display face for the headline, friendly humanist rounded sans for UI. Preserve Romanian diacritics exactly. Make the specified product data and both actions crisp and legible.
Constraints: Include every verbatim text string exactly once and preserve spelling, punctuation, en dash, diacritics, price, weight, and date. The visitor must immediately understand what is sold, trust the greenhouse origin, and be able to add Cutia Family to cart. The featured-product action cannot be visually secondary. Subtle section-line annotations may connect growing to packing, but they must remain visual storytelling, not become a scientific diagram. Use rounded forms throughout without turning everything into floating pill cards. Keep the compact footer identity direction compatible if a footer glimpse is shown.
Avoid: luxury editorial fashion styling; sterile minimalism; generic ShadCN cards; glassmorphism; purple; gradients used as decoration; poster composition; full-bleed slogan-only hero; scientific dashboard; heavy blueprint labeling; fake awards, testimonials, customer counts, certification marks, seals, or claims; business-to-business language; subscription framing; excessive whimsy; cartoon mascots; tiny unreadable UI; device mockups; browser chrome; watermark.
